kz_stat_bulletin.name: 'Об отдельных показателях преступности в Республике Казахстан' (selected crime indicators), January-December bulletins 2000-2004, table 'Число зарегистрированных (общеуголовных) преступлений в разрезе областей' column 'умышленное убийство и покушение на убийство'
kz_stat_bulletin.publisher: Agency of Statistics of the Republic of Kazakhstan (now Bureau of National Statistics, stat.gov.kz); 2003-2004 data from the Committee on Legal Statistics and Special Records of the Prosecutor General's Office
kz_stat_bulletin.notes: Count combines intentional murder AND attempted murder (the source does not separate them). RAR archives with HTML (2000-2003) or XLS (2004) tables; region values add up to the printed Republic total in every year (2000: 2,325; 2001: 2,160; 2002: 1,967; 2004: 2,091). For 2003 (total 1,991) the transport police rows have blank cells that make their column position ambiguous, so those three rows were left out; the 16 regions plus military (10) and penal system GUSP (8) give 1,988. Transport police, military and GUSP rows are kept without shapes. 2000-2002 'общеуголовных' (general criminal) crimes table; 2004 likewise.
